summary.critical: This is the most critical state in the system. The customer has already paid and still has no ticket.
summary.criticalMinistry: Ready to issue: the secretary has chosen and registered the passengers, and has no ticket yet.
summary.confirmFirst: Confirm the payment in the previous tab before issuing.

document.resendHint: WhatsApp opens with the client number, the message and the PDF link filled in, and is logged in Communications. The link opens the PDF without login. Resending by email sends the same file, with the same document number.
document.missingPdf: The case is issued but the PDF does not exist yet.
document.whatsappNoPhone: No client phone. Add a number to the request.

form.title: Issuance details
form.fromProposal: from the proposal · confirm before issuing
form.requiredLegend: * required to issue. Fields come prefilled from the chosen offer: confirm and complete what is missing.

tickets.title: Ticket per passenger
tickets.noPassengers: With no passengers submitted there is no one to issue a ticket to.
tickets.noSegments: The chosen offer has no saved segments, so there is nowhere to assign seats. Tickets can still be issued.

baggage.cabinKg: Weight per cabin piece, in kilos
baggage.checkedKg: Weight per checked bag, in kilos

flights.title: Document per flight
flights.airlinePnrHint: the airline's PNR, if different from ours
flights.baggageThrough: Baggage is checked through to the final destination, the passenger does not collect it at the {airport} connection

errors.title_one: {count} field missing before you can issue
errors.title_other: {count} fields missing before you can issue
errors.notPaid: The payment is not confirmed yet, confirm it in the Payment tab.
errors.ticketNumber: {pax} {name}: the ticket number is 3 airline digits + 10 document digits.
errors.duplicated: There are repeated ticket numbers, each passenger has their own.
errors.noPassengers: With no passengers submitted there is no one to issue a ticket to.

submit.issue: Issue, generate the ticket and notify the customer
submit.doneAfter: . The customer sees the tickets in their link.

warnings.badFormat: {flight}: NVB and NVA are written as 22OCT26 (day, month, year).
warnings.outOfRange: {flight}: the flight is on {date}, outside NVB {nvb} – NVA {nva}. Check the dates on the airline ticket.

hints.pnr: The booking reference in the reservation system (6 letters and numbers).
hints.carrier: The airline issuing the ticket. Sets the ticket number prefix.
hints.consolidator: Where the ticket was bought (e.g. Atlântida). Optional.
hints.costReal: What WeeFly paid for the ticket. Optional, used for the margin.
hints.fromOffer: From the chosen offer, local airport time.
hints.aircraft: This flight aircraft, as on the ticket (e.g. Airbus A321neo).
hints.cabinClass: Cabin (economy, business) and booking class letter (e.g. T).
hints.terminal: Only when the airport has terminals. May stay empty.
hints.coupon: This flight order on the ticket: 1 for the first, 2 for the second.
hints.fareBasis: This flight fare code, as on the ticket (e.g. TLXCV3).
hints.nvb: Not valid before: the ticket cannot be used before this date (e.g. 22OCT26).
hints.nva: Not valid after: the ticket cannot be used after this date (e.g. 22OCT26).
hints.endorsements: Restrictions printed on the ticket (e.g. NON-END / NON-REF).
